name: Silodosin US pivotal trials
question: Does silodosin improve lower urinary tract symptoms more than placebo in men with symptomatic BPH?

design.population: Men aged 50 years or older with IPSS at least 13 and peak urinary flow of 4–15 mL/s.
design.description: Pooled, multicenter, double-blind phase 3 randomized trials
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods and Results; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00224107 and NCT00224120

verdictNote: Symptom improvement favored silodosin; ejaculation-related adverse events were substantially more frequent.
takeaway: Across two randomized US phase 3 trials, silodosin 8 mg daily improved IPSS more than placebo within 3–4 days, with a significant difference persisting through 12 weeks; reported retrograde ejaculation was more frequent with silodosin.

reports.label: Pooled 12-week report
reports.citation: Marks LS, Gittelman MC, Hill LA, Volinn W, Hoel G. "Rapid efficacy of the highly selective alpha1A-adrenoceptor antagonist silodosin in men with signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia: pooled results of 2 phase 3 studies." *J Urol.* 2009;181(6):2634-2640. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2009.02.034

results.measure: Change from baseline to last observation; between-group superiority sustained through week 12
results.note: The abstract reports the week-12 significance but not the last-observation group means.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods and Results

results.measure: Mean change from baseline after 3–4 days; mean difference −1.9 points
results.note: Early assessment at 0.5 week, range 3–4 days; SDs accompany group means.

results.measure: Mean change from baseline 2–6 hours after first dose; mean difference 1.3 mL/s
results.note: Between-group difference remained significant through week 12 (P <0.001).

harms.label: Treatment-emergent retrograde ejaculation
harms.note: Mostly mild; event counts are not given in the abstract.

delivery.label: Blinded dosing
delivery.value: Silodosin 8 mg or placebo once daily with breakfast for 12 weeks.

reports.label: 40-week open-label extension
reports.citation: Marks LS, Gittelman MC, Hill LA, Volinn W, Hoel G. "Silodosin in the treatment of the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia: a 9-month, open-label extension study." *Urology.* 2009;74(6):1318-1322. doi:10.1016/j.urology.2009.06.072

results.measure: Observed-case mean change during extension to week 40, grouped by prior randomized treatment
results.note: Both extension groups received silodosin; these are within-group changes from the extension baseline, not a randomized comparison.

delivery.label: Extension completion
delivery.value: 435/661 (65.8%) completed 40 weeks of open-label silodosin 8 mg daily with breakfast.
